# Ledger

> Exact-decimal double-entry kernel for AI agents. Do not compute money in tokens. Call the kernel.

The TypeScript package `@eternal-roman/ledger` is the canonical kernel. The MCP server `@eternal-roman/ledger-mcp` is the agent interface. Invalid entries are rejected, never posted.

## Start

- Agent contract: /AGENTS.md
- Protocol: /docs/CORE-PROTOCOL.md
- MCP how-to: /mcp/README.md
- Machine tool catalog (when the server is running): ledger://tools/catalog
- Pre-ship checklist: /docs/SUCCESS-CHECKLIST.md
- What the kernel rejects: /docs/ANTI-PATTERNS.md
- What ships today: /docs/SCOPE-AND-LAYERS.md

## Install

```
npx -y @eternal-roman/ledger-mcp
npm install @eternal-roman/ledger
npx ledger-verify --scan .
```

MCP config:

```
{ "mcpServers": { "ledger": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@eternal-roman/ledger-mcp"] } } }
```

## Invariants

- Money.from (or money_compute) for every amount. No floats.
- JournalEntry, >= 2 lines, balanced per currency, ISO date, no silent FX.
- Ledger.apply is immutable and re-validates. Fail-closed.
- auditHash is ledger-audit-v2 (account type + name included). Do not fabricate it.
- Fundamental equation: Assets + Expenses = Liabilities + Equity + Income, per currency.

## Tools (MCP)

money_compute, entry_validate, ledger_post, ledger_balance, ledger_trial_balance, ledger_verify_equation, ledger_audit_hash, ledger_verify_determinism, trace_run, cite_lookup, artifact_make, periods_create_lock, periods_guarded_post, closing_generate_entries, fx_compute_translation, depreciation_build_schedule, cashflow_statement, reconcile_positions, portfolio_relief, settlement_build_entries.

## Skills / commands

/ledger-verify, /ledger-audit, /ledger-cite, /ledger-reconcile, /ledger-sim, /ledger-review. Skill sources under /skills/.

## Optional layers

Trading, portfolio lots, returns, crypto transfers, IFRS 16 lessee, period locks, closing, FX translation, depreciation, cash flow, reconcile — all emit kernel JournalEntry objects. See /examples/.

## Not this

Not a database. Not a bank. Not advice. Citation graph is a starter set; verify against official standards.
